complete_examples.text: Different from other high-efficient techniques, for example, the 2.5D finite element method (Yang and Hung, 2001) and the periodic finite element model (Degrande et al., 2006), the hybrid model can describe the complex wheel-rail nonlinear contact behavior by the nonlinear Hertz contact and the creep theory.
